name: Avalanche
description: AVAX is the native token of the Avalanche network — used to pay gas fees on all three chains and to secure the network via staking. It is not a contract, so it has no contract address.

name: AVAX Toolbox Token
description: Value token for AVXTO Wallet and the AVAX Toolbox, a suite of tools for Avalanche users and developers.

name: SomeToken
description: Fuji testnet counterpart to AVXTO, for development and testing.

name: Pangolin
description: Governance and fee-sharing token of Pangolin, a community-driven decentralized exchange on Avalanche.

name: Wrapped AVAX
description: ERC20-wrapped AVAX, used where a contract requires a token interface rather than the native gas asset (e.g. DEX liquidity pools).

name: Ether
description: Bridged representation of Ethereum's native ETH on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Tether USD
description: Bridged representation of Tether's USDT stablecoin on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: ChainLink Token
description: Bridged representation of Chainlink's LINK token, used to pay for oracle services on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Aave Token
description: Bridged representation of Aave's governance token on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Uniswap
description: Bridged representation of Uniswap's governance token on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Wrapped BTC
description: Bridged representation of Wrapped Bitcoin on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Maker
description: Bridged representation of MakerDAO's governance token on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Synthetix Network Token
description: Bridged representation of Synthetix's governance and collateral token on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Compound
description: Bridged representation of Compound's governance token on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: HuobiToken
description: Bridged representation of Huobi's exchange token on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: SushiToken
description: Bridged representation of SushiSwap's governance token on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: UMA Voting Token v1
description: Bridged representation of UMA's governance and voting token on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Binance USD
description: Bridged representation of Paxos's (formerly Binance-branded) USD-pegged stablecoin on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: Dai Stablecoin
description: Bridged representation of MakerDAO's decentralized USD-pegged stablecoin on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: PHAR Token
description: Native token of Pharaoh Exchange, a concentrated-liquidity DEX on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: xPHAR Token
description: Escrowed, vote-governance form of PHAR on Pharaoh Exchange.

name: p33
description: Token listed in Pharaoh Exchange's own contract-address registry on the Avalanche C-Chain.

name: The Arena
description: Token of Arena.social, a decentralized socialfi app on Avalanche where creators monetize their audience via share trading, tipping and exclusive communities.

name: LFJ (formerly Trader Joe)
description: Native token of LFJ, a decentralized exchange on Avalanche offering swapping, staking, yield farming and lending (Banker Joe).
